# autoants Verified Pros

> Licensed, insured New Orleans contractors with recent permits, one page per trade and neighborhood. Every fact carries its public source and date. Listed A to Z; the order says nothing about quality.

Last refreshed: 2026-10-20
Disclosure: Some listed contractors pay Lane Davis II a referral fee when he introduces a customer; that never affects who's listed or the order.
Verify: Verify any license at lslbc.louisiana.gov.
Corrections and removals: hello@autoants.com
